name: Four Points by Sheraton Bekasi
short_description: Select-service Four Points in the Pakuwon Mall Bekasi Superblock in Bekasi, a satellite city of Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek), directly connected to the mall and steps from Bekasi Barat LRT station.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Bekasi opened on 22 September 2025 as the brand's first hotel in Bekasi and the 14th Four Points in Indonesia. It occupies the upper floors of the Pakuwon Mall Bekasi Superblock in Pekayon Jaya, with a sky lobby reported on the 23rd floor and roughly 242 contemporary rooms and suites. The property is directly connected to Pakuwon Mall Bekasi and its 200-plus retail and dining outlets and sits steps from Bekasi Barat LRT station, giving easy access into central Jakarta. It forms a 'double-decker' dual-hotel complex with the adjacent Fairfield by Marriott Bekasi, sharing the superblock. Facilities cited in the opening press and early coverage include a rooftop pool with a children's area, a 24-hour fitness center, a wellness/spa center, an all-day dining restaurant serving Betawi and Sundanese cuisine, a rooftop lounge and bar, and extensive event space (two ballrooms plus meeting rooms, largest ballroom to about 1,200 guests). As a very new hotel, verified independent guest feedback is limited; a TripAdvisor listing exists with a strong early rating, but sample sizes are small and should be treated cautiously. Bekasi is a Greater Jakarta satellite city rather than central Jakarta.

faqs.question: When did Four Points by Sheraton Bekasi open?
faqs.answer: It opened on 22 September 2025 as the first Four Points by Sheraton in Bekasi and the 14th in Indonesia.

faqs.question: Is the hotel connected to Pakuwon Mall Bekasi?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel is integrated into the Pakuwon Mall Bekasi Superblock with direct indoor access to the mall's 200-plus shops and dining outlets, and it sits steps from Bekasi Barat LRT station.

faqs.question: Is Bekasi part of Jakarta?
faqs.answer: Bekasi is a separate city in West Java within the Greater Jakarta metropolitan area (Jabodetabek), east of central Jakarta rather than in the city proper. Soekarno-Hatta airport is roughly 50 km away.

reviews.title: Indonesia: Four Points by Sheraton Bekasi, an Urban Oasis in West Java
reviews.author: Michael Taylor
reviews.summary: Blog review of the newly opened hotel: 242 rooms with floor-to-ceiling city views, Djaman Doeloe Betawi/Sundanese restaurant, rooftop Botanique lounge and pool, spa and 24-hour gym, plus direct Pakuwon Mall access via the superblock.
